review:
A Norse Megaways game with up to 117,649 ways – and a hammer that gives the base game real moments. When it lands sideways on the top row, every symbol underneath turns wild.

The free spins trigger is unusual: you have to spell THOR with the scatter letters. In the bonus, a multiplier rises with every tumble, so long cascades are what make it pay. Up to 5,000x, 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
